description: Porter Five Forces analysis — Porter Five Forces analysis of an industry (required) with optional region, perspective (who is deciding, e.g. a new entrant) and context (your own facts). Returns each force (rivalry, new entrants, supplier power, buyer power, substitutes) with 1-5 intensity, HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW level, trend and drivers; industry attractiveness score and verdict ATTRACTIVE/MODERATE/UNATTRACTIVE computed offline; strongest/weakest force, rising pressures, key suppliers/buyers/substitutes, profit pool, strategic moves, watch signals, assumptions and markdown. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
